يفتقد (form VIII)
# يَفْتَقِدُ (yaftaqidu) /jaf.ta.qi.du/: third-person masculine singular non-past active indicative of اِفْتَقَدَ (iftaqada)
# يُفْتَقَدُ (yuftaqadu) /juf.ta.qa.du/: third-person masculine singular non-past passive indicative of اِفْتَقَدَ (iftaqada)
# يَفْتَقِدَ (yaftaqida) /jaf.ta.qi.da/: third-person masculine singular non-past active subjunctive of اِفْتَقَدَ (iftaqada)
